verdict.rationale: Wise has an extensive API reference at docs.wise.com/api-reference and a separate sandbox environment, but nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples. A static reference plus a separate sandbox is adjacent, not the capability itself. The only published OpenAPI spec covers the legacy webhook API, and the probes for a main spec returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
